$comment: Known answers for the rent vs buy comparison. The whole comparison has no single published answer (every source makes different assumptions), so each part is checked on its own: published worked examples found via web search on 2026-10-09 (direct fetch blocked in the build environment) for rent with yearly escalation and for the EMI, and tools-core/test/rentVsBuy.test.ts checks the rest against closed forms — loan balance (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortgage_calculator), compound growth (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compound_interest) and the geometric series (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geometric_series).
